scenarios.title: Large PRs, senior Java, high complexity

top_recommendation.practice_title: Slice work into small, single-concern PRs
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Median PR size: 720 lines; Review rounds per PR: 3.4 rounds; PR cycle time: 72 hours. Practice guideline: under 400 changed lines, 1-2 review rounds.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: On your next ticket, ask Claude Code (start in plan mode, skill: pr-slicing) to propose 2-3 slices of under 400 lines before writing code; for Java / Spring Boot work, keep API contract (OpenAPI / DTO) changes in a separate PR from service logic. Pair it with a short PR-size note in the repo's AGENTS.md so agents propose slices by default.

top_recommendation.practice_title: Slice work into small, single-concern PRs
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Median PR size: 560 lines; Review rounds per PR: 3.0 rounds; PR cycle time: 60 hours. Practice guideline: under 400 changed lines, 1-2 review rounds.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: On your next ticket, ask Copilot Chat (/slice-pr) to propose 2-3 slices of under 400 lines before writing code; for .NET / C# work, ship EF Core migrations separately from feature logic. Share the proposed slices with your reviewer before you start, so the split is agreed early.

scenarios.title: Many review rounds on small PRs, mid TypeScript

top_recommendation.practice_title: Run an AI readiness self-check before requesting review
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Review rounds per PR: 3.1 rounds; PR template used: 20%; CI first-pass rate: 86%. Practice guideline: most reviews should close in 1-2 rounds.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Before requesting review, run /pr-readiness in Copilot Chat (or the pr-readiness-selfcheck skill in Claude Code). It checks tests, description, risks and debug leftovers and runs `npm test` so reviewers see evidence up front.

scenarios.title: CI failures with heavy agent use, mid Python

top_recommendation.practice_title: Make the agent show test evidence before 'done'
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: CI first-pass rate: 55%; Agent-mode share: 62%; Review rounds per PR: 1.6 rounds. Practice guideline: 85%+ of pushes pass CI the first time.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Add one line to your agent requests: 'Run `pytest -q` and lint, paste the summary, and do not say done without it.' The verification-before-completion skill does this automatically in Claude Code and Copilot.

scenarios.title: Few tests per PR, mid Java

top_recommendation.practice_title: Derive tests from acceptance criteria first
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Tests added per PR: 0.4 tests; Time to create tests: 110 minutes; Tests written first: 5%. Practice guideline: every behavior change ships with tests (2+ per PR is typical).
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Paste the story's acceptance criteria into Copilot Chat with /test-plan, review the happy, negative and boundary cases, then use /write-tests to generate JUnit 5 with Mockito tests before or alongside the implementation.

scenarios.title: Slow manual test writing, senior .NET

top_recommendation.practice_title: Derive tests from acceptance criteria first
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Time to create tests: 150 minutes; AI-assisted test share: 10%; Tests written first: 50%. Practice guideline: draft the test plan with AI, then refine; aim for under 60 minutes per PR.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Let the agent draft the first version: give Copilot agent mode the acceptance criteria plus one existing xUnit with Moq test as a style example (/write-tests), then spend your time reviewing assertions instead of typing boilerplate.

scenarios.title: Flaky AI-generated Playwright tests, SDET

top_recommendation.practice_title: Harden AI-generated tests against flakiness
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Flaky test rate: 10%; AI-assisted test share: 75%; CI first-pass rate: 86%. Practice guideline: flaky rate under 2%; AI-generated tests reviewed for waits and shared state.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Before merging AI-generated tests, run /fix-flaky-test or the flaky-test-hardening skill: use web-first assertions and role-based locators instead of waitForTimeout, and run the suite 3 times locally to confirm stability.

scenarios.title: Long agent sessions, junior Python, high complexity

top_recommendation.practice_title: Plan first, then implement in small steps
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Chat turns per agent session: 19 turns; Abandoned agent sessions: 42%; Sessions started with a plan: 10%. Practice guideline: well-scoped sessions usually finish in under 10 turns.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Start complex sessions in Claude Code plan mode with the writing-plans skill: get a numbered plan (files, steps, tests, risks), approve it, then run one step per session. Restart a session instead of steering past 10 turns. Ask a teammate to sanity-check the first plan.

scenarios.title: Long agent sessions, mid TypeScript, medium complexity

top_recommendation.practice_title: Plan first, then implement in small steps
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Chat turns per agent session: 15 turns; Abandoned agent sessions: 20%; Sessions started with a plan: 20%. Practice guideline: well-scoped sessions usually finish in under 10 turns.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Open sessions with /jira-to-plan in Copilot Chat to get a short plan first, approve it, then implement step by step. Restart with a fresh brief instead of steering past 10 turns.

scenarios.title: No repo instructions with agent mode, lead Java

top_recommendation.practice_title: Give agents a short, human-written context pack
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Repo has agent instructions: no; Agent-mode share: 60%; Chat turns per agent session: 6.5 turns. Practice guideline: every repo used with agents has a short AGENTS.md or copilot-instructions.md.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Run /create-agents-md in Copilot Chat once to draft an AGENTS.md (build and test commands, conventions, guardrails), edit it by hand to keep it short, and commit it. Copilot, Claude Code and Devin all read it. As a lead, this is a 30-minute task that helps everyone on the repo.

scenarios.title: Coding agent used for emails, mid .NET

top_recommendation.practice_title: Route each task to the right tool
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Non-code tasks in coding agent: 6 per week. Practice guideline: documents, emails and summaries belong in a writing assistant.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Move status updates, emails and document rewrites to your approved writing assistant (for example Microsoft 365 Copilot where enabled) and keep the coding agents for code. Use the right-tool-for-task skill when unsure.

scenarios.title: Repo-wide migration done in chat, lead Python

top_recommendation.practice_title: Route each task to the right tool
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Large multi-file tasks done in chat: 5 per week; Devin sessions: 0 per week. Practice guideline: long, well-specified, repo-wide work suits an asynchronous agent with a playbook.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: For repo-wide, well-specified work (upgrades, migrations, repetitive fixes), hand it to Devin with the modernization-migration or dependency-upgrade playbook and review the PR, instead of driving it turn by turn in chat.

scenarios.title: Low tool adoption, junior Java

top_recommendation.practice_title: 30-minute guided starter path
top_recommendation.observation: Over the last 4 weeks: Copilot sessions: 1 per week; Claude Code sessions: 0 per week. Optional: a short guided path to try the tools you already have on a real ticket.
top_recommendation.suggested_action: Try the 30-minute starter path on a real ticket: (1) add a context pack, (2) ask for a plan first, (3) run the readiness self-check before review. Entirely optional.
